verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud data platform that ships a CLI, drivers, and a web UI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Query History and Access History are customer-facing auditing features, not opt-out controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
